lines.text: 服务员拿来了四个盒子，客户都给了王明：“你们年轻人工作忙，这些拿回去，明天中午就不用买饭了。”

lines.en: The waiter brings four boxes, and the client gives them all to Wang Ming. "You young people are so busy. Take these with you, and you won't need to buy lunch tomorrow."

tr.es: El mesero trae cuatro recipientes, y el cliente se los da todos a Wang Ming: «Ustedes los jóvenes trabajan mucho. Llévense esto, y mañana no tienen que comprar almuerzo».

lines.text: 第二天中午，王明在办公室吃着那条鱼，经理走过来说：“那条鱼还有吗？其实我昨天也想打包。”

lines.en: The next lunchtime, Wang Ming is eating the fish in the office when his manager comes over. "Is there any of that fish left? Actually, I wanted a box yesterday too."
